title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Community Service and Problem Solving
prompt: In many communities, local problems such as litter, loneliness among older residents, and unsafe public spaces are increasingly addressed by volunteer groups rather than by government agencies. Some people believe that community service should be a required part of secondary school education, while others argue that volunteering must remain a personal choice. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为雅思学术类写作 Task 2 模拟练习。请仔细阅读 prompt 中的英文题目，并按照要求写一篇不少于 250 词的议论文。题目要求讨论双方观点并给出你自己的看法，请确保立场明确、论证充分。注意：本题中的所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。建议先用 2-3 分钟审题并构思，再用 35 分钟左右完成写作，最后留出 5 分钟检查语法与拼写。
